title: Typed article and source-aware inline editing

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:fraction-notebook; npm run typecheck:fraction-notebook; npm run visual:fraction-notebook; npm run check:architecture; npm run test:project-vision
verificationRecords.scope: typed article, metadata, migration and typography candidate
verificationRecords.notes: Nine unit/preservation checks, eight Chromium checks and 75 orientation checks pass. Scoped types and architecture pass. Real browser v1 migration preserves original storage; header boundaries, authors/roles, metadata and local caption survive editing and reload. Typography remains a human-review candidate.
Initial passes exposed a KaTeX inline hit-area and stale blur during Redo. Both repaired at the NodeView boundary; final full ten-test run passes.
Twelve model and preservation tests pass, including conversion history and copy identities.
All ten Chromium checks pass: source entry, history, invalid recovery, metadata, composed input, copy IDs and reader closure.
Full app, node, tests, Svelte and domain checks pass.
All architecture, compiler authority and cross-domain gates pass.
